text.arabic_uthmani: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ

words.gloss_range: passive completed permission or authorization, with the granting agent unexpressed and the authorized group brought forward by the following preposition
words.root_gloss_range: permission, hearing, notification, and proclamation are available in the root family; the local passive perfect selects authorization while retaining an audible public-notice pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أُذِنَ}} ({{tr:udhina}}) opens with a completed passive authorization: permission has been issued, but the issuer is grammatically withheld. In the supplied profile this passive-perfect authorization is singular, so the form itself marks the legal opening as unusual. The root family lets permission sound like something heard or proclaimed, while the local passive keeps the focus on the received legal clearance. That first passive beat starts the ayah's movement from prior protection (22:38) into concrete authorization, before the later named divine subject resolves the agency pattern.

topics.headline: agentless completed permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with permission already granted while the granting agent is withheld from the verb.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a passive perfect with no explicit agent, and contextual evidence marks this exact form as singular in the supplied profile.

topics.headline: permission with audible announcement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that authorization is not merely internal allowance; the root family gives it a heard public-notice edge.
topics.reason: The local sense is permission, but the supplied root and form-family evidence coherently preserves hearing, notification, and proclamation pressure.

topics.headline: prior defense becomes legal authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's first word converts the preceding defense principle (22:38) into a concrete permission event.
topics.reason: The rows tie the opening passive to the ayah's authorization-cause-assurance architecture and to the 22:38 to 22:39 boundary.

topics.headline: initial sound texture
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The hamza-onset observation adds sound color but no separate lexical or structural payoff beyond the retained opening-authorization topic.
topics.reason: The sound observation is not needed once the opening legal-declaration topic preserves the reader-facing boundary payoff.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the recipient and beneficiary of the permission, fused onto the relative head that follows
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) directs the passive permission toward a defined recipient rather than leaving it abstract. Its recipient and benefactive force are both active, while any purpose nuance remains secondary because the particle governs the following relative group. In the fused phrase, the authorized party is heard immediately after the permission before the reason is supplied.

topics.headline: permission routed to the fought group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the permission is aimed at a legally specified beneficiary before the ayah gives the reason.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following relative pronoun the governed recipient of the passive permission verb.

topics.headline: benefit and purpose pressure under dative governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle carries benefit and possible purpose pressure, while grammar keeps recipienthood primary.
topics.reason: The lām can carry purpose or benefit, but the local governed relative phrase makes dative recipienthood the controlling function.

topics.headline: preposition bound to the relative head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the authorized recipient is not loosely adjacent; the preposition is formally bound to the relative head.
topics.reason: The surface fusion audibly and graphically binds the preposition to the following relative group.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun defining the authorized class through the following passive combat predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:lladhīna}}) does not name the group by tribe or title; it opens a relative clause that defines them by what is being done to them. Its fused form compresses the preposition, definiteness, and relative head into one heard unit. Its plural agreement keeps the recipient, the fought group, the pronoun in the cause clause, and the wronged group aligned as one class. Across the boundary, that class continues from believers in 22:38 into people specified by hostile pressure and wronging.

topics.headline: class defined by the following predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that legal identity is condition-based: the authorized group is defined by being fought, not by a fixed name.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a masculine plural relative pronoun whose clause is completed by the following passive verb.

topics.headline: one plural group through recipient, cause, and injury
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar prevents the permission recipient and the wronged people from becoming different groups.
topics.reason: Plural agreement routes later verbs and suffixes back to the same relative class.

topics.headline: compact fused relative unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the preposition, definiteness, and relative head are compressed into one heard unit.
topics.reason: The surface form reflects fusion after the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: class continues across neighboring ayahs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same community is re-profiled across the boundary, from protected believers (22:38) to those being fought and later expelled (22:40).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete neighboring references and preserve the class-continuity payoff.

words.gloss_range: Form III passive/imperfect combat predicate: the relative class is being fought, with accepted variant evidence exposing the agency pressure point
words.root_gloss_range: the root ranges across killing, combat, subduing, and related hostile engagement; the local Form III passive selects being fought against rather than bare killing or self-initiated fighting
words.prose: {{ar:يُقَٰتَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yuqātalūna}}) completes the relative class: these are people being fought. The Form III stem keeps the adversarial combat field, while the passive voice makes them the side receiving that pressure. Variant evidence that can read the form actively exposes the legal hinge, but the canonical passive makes the permission defensive rather than a license detached from being attacked. The same root-field links this permission to fighting language in 2:190 and later harm-and-reward language in 22:58.

topics.headline: authorized people as those being fought
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permission is attached to patienthood under attack, not simply to combat participation.
topics.reason: QAC licenses the passive Form III parse, and attachment ties its subject to the relative class.

topics.headline: combat root narrowed from killing to being fought
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word belongs to reciprocal hostile engagement, while local voice and stem prevent reducing it to bare killing.
topics.reason: Root and form-family evidence preserve adversarial pressure, but the local Form III passive narrows the selected sense.

topics.headline: combat field joins defensive permission contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this combat predicate makes the prior defense theme concrete and belongs to a wider defensive q-t-l field (2:190; 22:58).
topics.reason: The cited rows provide concrete references linking this local combat role to surrounding and cross-surah combat language.

topics.headline: knowledge-suppression overread
topics.blocking_evidence: QAC and attachment evidence select passive hostile engagement, and no local grammar or contextual evidence makes knowledge suppression the active sense.
topics.reason: The local word is a Form III passive combat predicate in a permission-for-defense frame; the knowledge-mastery branch is not licensed as a local semantic payoff.

topics.headline: combat word consonant texture
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The consonant-texture observation is decorative here and adds no separate reader-facing lexical or grammatical insight.
topics.reason: The retained combat-role topics already preserve the word's structural and lexical payoff.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition governing the following anna-clause as the reason for permission
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the wronging clause the legal ground of the permission. The attachment evidence favors its connection to the permission verb, so wronging functions as cause rather than as a loose circumstance. Instrumental or accompaniment shades survive only as the evidentiary way the group carries its case: the governing role remains causal. This particle also carries the move from prior defense (22:38) to present authorization and toward the expulsion evidence in 22:40.

topics.headline: wronging as the legal cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permission is justified by a stated cause, not left as an unexplained authorization.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation support identify the following clause as causal content explaining the permission.

topics.headline: possible attachment pressure resolved toward permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the attachment pressure, while the local syntax keeps the dominant reading tied to permission rather than to the fighting verb.
topics.reason: The row's alternative is grammatically conceivable, but the provided attachment analysis marks the clause as complement of the permission verb.

topics.headline: whole proposition governed by the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a full asserted wronging proposition, not a single noun, is turned into the cause.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following anna-clause, allowing cause and evidentiary credential to be packaged together.

topics.headline: cause links defense to authorization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the causal particle is the hinge by which prior defense becomes present permission and later expulsion evidence (22:40).
topics.reason: The boundary rows preserve the particle's role in connecting local justification with neighboring defense logic.

words.gloss_range: annulment/nominalizing particle with plural suffix, packaging the wronging as a governed fact about the same group
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:annahum}}) turns the following passive injury into a governed fact: because they were wronged. The attached plural suffix routes that fact back to the relative group, so the cause is not general injustice but their own case. It also contrasts with the later emphatic particle: this word subordinates the legal ground, while the later particle independently asserts divine capacity.

topics.headline: wronging packaged as causal fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reason for permission is presented as an established fact, not as a speculative event.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence show the particle introducing a governed nominalized content clause.

topics.headline: plural suffix identifies the wronged group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun binds the causal fact to the same people who were just defined as being fought.
topics.reason: The suffix is the governed noun of the particle and refers back to the plural relative group.

topics.headline: subordinate cause versus independent assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's two-particle structure: one packages the cause, the other launches the assurance.
topics.reason: The local clauses separate the governed causal unit from the later independent emphatic nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect passive plural: they have been wronged, with the wrongdoer unexpressed and the injury established as the cause of permission
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, injustice, deprivation, misplacement, and darkness belong to the root field; the local passive selects imposed injustice while retaining deprivation and obscuring pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ظُلِمُوا۟}} ({{tr:ẓulimū}}) names the legal cause as an already imposed injury: they were wronged. The passive again withholds the agent, matching the earlier agentless permission and combat forms, and the supplied profile makes this passive-perfect injury distributionally marked. The plural agreement keeps the harmed group identical with the permission recipient. The root field adds deprivation, misplacement, and darkness pressure, so the wronging reads as a state needing restoration, later specified by expulsion in 22:40.

topics.headline: established wronging without named oppressor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that permission answers an already imposed injury while the grammar does not name the oppressor.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect passive plural and the attachment profile leaves the agent unexpressed.

topics.headline: same group wronged, fought, and permitted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grammar binds the harmed people to the same relative class that received permission.
topics.reason: The 3mp ending agrees with the suffix and the earlier relative group.

topics.headline: injustice as deprivation, misplacement, and darkness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wronging is not a flat moral label; it carries deprivation, misplacement, and obscuring pressure, while local grammar keeps imposed injustice as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root-family images are coherent with the legal injury but must remain secondary to the local passive wronging sense.

topics.headline: self-suffering and mutual wronging left outside the parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents one-sided imposed injury, not self-internalized suffering or reciprocal wronging.
topics.reason: Alternative form families sharpen the local choice by contrast; they do not replace the passive parse.

topics.headline: passive chain before divine assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a chain of withheld human agents that prepares for the later explicit divine subject and capacity.
topics.reason: The word participates in the ayah's passive-to-explicit-agency movement.

topics.headline: wronging triggers aid and is specified forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that compact wronging in 22:39 opens a justice thread that is concretized by expulsion in 22:40 and answered by aid.
topics.reason: The rows connect wronging to authorization, aid, same-surah justice language, and the following ayah.

topics.headline: heavy sound of imposed wronging
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound-texture observation adds color but no distinct reader-facing payoff for this processing layer.
topics.reason: The retained topics already preserve the legal, lexical, and structural force of the passive injury.

words.gloss_range: conjunction or resumptive/circumstantial pivot into the emphatic assurance clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge out of the permission-and-cause sequence into assurance. Read resumptively, it opens a fresh assertion; read circumstantially, it says divine capacity is already present while permission is granted. Its bound form makes the light connective run straight into the emphatic particle. Either way, it joins the beats without flattening them, moving from human passive affectedness toward the named divine subject.

topics.headline: resumptive or circumstantial hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is both connected to the legal cause and newly emphatic as assurance.
topics.reason: QAC allows conjunction, and the rows preserve the resumptive and circumstantial readings without contradiction.

topics.headline: turn from passive sequence to named divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction marks the ayah's turn from suppressed agents to explicit divine capacity.
topics.reason: The following emphatic clause names the divine subject after the passive sequence.

topics.headline: conjunction fused to emphatic particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connective immediately enters the emphatic particle, making the transition both joined and forceful.
topics.reason: The surface form binds the conjunction to the following emphatic particle.

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulling particle governing the divine name and setting up the final predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) launches the closing assurance as an emphatic nominal clause rather than another event. It governs the divine name as subject and the final predicate as the clause's asserted news, while the later predicate-lām adds a second layer of confirmation. The n-n and m nasal thread also links the assertion to the group's aid phrase. The effect is stable capacity, not narrated helping yet.

topics.headline: emphatic subject-predicate frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine capacity is asserted as a standing relation, not narrated as a new verb.
topics.reason: The particle governs the divine name and sets up the predicate in the final nominal clause.

topics.headline: inna plus predicate lām assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing assurance is heavily confirmed at the exact point where permission has been legally grounded.
topics.reason: The rows link the particle with predicate lām and the qualitative final attribute.

topics.headline: sound binds assertion to aid
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small audible tie between assertion and the group's aid phrase.
topics.reason: The sound observation is concrete and tied to the closing assurance wording.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name as the governed subject of the emphatic clause
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine naming, worship/deity, refuge, and contested longing/bewilderment pressures are available; the local form selects the definite divine proper name as subject of capacity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is the first named subject after the chain of passive forms. As the governed subject of the emphatic particle, the divine name anchors the assurance in God rather than in abstract power. Refuge pressure fits a group under attack, and the contested worship/deity versus longing/bewilderment derivational pressure may color the naming without replacing the proper-name parse. The local payoff is grammatical and theological: the named divine subject answers the earlier withheld agency and leads into capability over their aid, participating in the surah's divine-capability field (22:6; 22:39).

topics.headline: explicit divine subject after agentless clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural reversal: after passive human affectedness, the ayah names God as the subject of capacity.
topics.reason: The rows and attachment evidence show three earlier passive forms followed by an emphatic clause with the divine name.

topics.headline: accusative subject of inna
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name is grammatically governed into the assurance, not standing as a detached invocation.
topics.reason: QAC marks the proper noun as accusative, and attachment makes it the governed noun of the emphatic particle.

topics.headline: proper divine name with refuge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assurance is anchored in the unique divine proper name, with refuge pressure fitting the attacked group while not replacing the name's local function.
topics.reason: The local word is a definite proper name; branch pressures are retained only as coloring that fits the aid context.

topics.headline: worship and longing pressures under the proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that contested derivational pressure can deepen the naming, while the local grammar still selects the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is valid as background pressure but cannot displace the proper-name parse.

topics.headline: divine name joined to capability assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the specific promise of aid participates in Surah 22's broader divine-capability field (22:6; 22:39).
topics.reason: The rows cite the divine-name recurrence and the capability formula connection with concrete surah references.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the aid noun as the domain over which capability is asserted
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) scopes the final predicate: the capacity asserted is over their aid, not left as an unqualified formula. Its upon/over force becomes mastery over the aid-domain, while any obligation shade remains subordinate to capability. Because the prepositional phrase comes before the final predicate, the reader hears the domain before the climactic attribute lands.

topics.headline: aid as the specified domain of capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine capability is locally scoped to their aid rather than left as a generic formula.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the aid noun the governed complement of the final capability predicate through this preposition.

topics.headline: upon/over and obligation pressure under capability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mastery-over-aid pressure, while the clause does not become a separate legal obligation claim.
topics.reason: The local attachment to the capability predicate makes capability primary and keeps obligation-shadow secondary.

topics.headline: domain heard before predicate peak
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the domain of capacity before the final attribute closes the verse.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement precedes the final predicate in the closing clause.

words.gloss_range: genitive verbal noun in construct with a plural suffix: their specific aid, victory, or support against an adversary
words.root_gloss_range: aid, victory, adversarial support, mutual assistance, self-vindication, and early-rain provision are in the root field; the local construct selects possessed aid-victory under divine capability
words.prose: {{ar:نَصْرِهِمْ}} ({{tr:naṣrihim}}) makes the promised aid definite and personal: it is their aid, routed back to the group fought and wronged. The noun can compress being helped and gaining victory, and its adversarial sense answers the combat predicate. Mutual help and self-vindication remain secondary because the phrase is governed under divine capability, shifting aid from the earlier withheld-agency pattern into a claimed divine resource. The root's early-rain image can color the aid as first provision after deprivation, and 22:40 turns this noun into a sworn helping verb.

topics.headline: aid belongs to the harmed group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assurance is not generic help; it is aid-victory tied by suffix to the same wronged group.
topics.reason: The construct verbal noun with plural suffix is governed by the preposition and made definite by the group pronoun.

topics.headline: recipient and outcome compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun holds both being helped and the resulting victory as a stable domain of capacity.
topics.reason: The maṣdar in construct can name aid as both object-directed support and outcome-domain.

topics.headline: opponent-facing aid under divine frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the aid is opponent-facing and restorative, while mutual help or self-vindication do not govern the local syntax.
topics.reason: The combat context supports adversarial aid, but divine-capacity governance blocks turning the phrase into human self-vindication.

topics.headline: first-rain provision image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an image of aid as inaugural provision after deprivation, while battlefield aid-victory remains the local selected sense.
topics.reason: The early-rain image is a valid root-family pressure but must remain secondary to the local aid-victory phrase.

topics.headline: aid framed as divine capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that aid moves from withheld agency into a divine-capacity frame rather than being merely a human resource.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence rows and local syntax join the aid noun to the divine name and final capability predicate.

topics.headline: noun becomes sworn help in the next ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 22:39 states aid as the domain of capacity and 22:40 turns the same root into pledged action.
topics.reason: The rows cite the concrete forward pickup in 22:40 and same-surah support thread.

topics.headline: nasal sound around the pronoun
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound observation does not add a separate lexical or syntactic payoff beyond the retained suffix and aid-domain topics.
topics.reason: The possessed-aid topic already captures the pronoun's structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: emphatic predicate lām prefixed to the final adjective under the inna construction
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) fastens confirmation directly onto the final predicate. It does not add lexical content on its own; it makes the capacity claim arrive as reinforced news under the earlier emphatic particle. The final word enters with emphasis already attached, so the attribute is not neutral description but the emphatic closure of the assurance.

topics.headline: confirmation attached to the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis falls on the capacity predicate, the exact claim the closing clause needs to confirm.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as emphatic lām and attachment makes the following adjective the predicate.

topics.headline: emphasis fused onto the closing word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word enters with emphasis already attached to it.
topics.reason: The lām is prefixed to the final predicate form.

topics.headline: second layer of confirmation with inna
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing assurance is doubly confirmed because the situation requires a maximally asserted promise.
topics.reason: The row links the predicate lām with the earlier emphatic particle in the same clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intensive adjective as the final predicate: capable, with power understood as measured and determining capacity over their aid
words.root_gloss_range: capacity, power, determining, measuring, apportioning, and enabling belong to the root field; the local adjective selects stable divine capability scoped by the preceding aid phrase
words.prose: {{ar:قَدِيرٌ}} ({{tr:qadīrun}}) completes the emphatic clause and seals the ayah. It is not an unqualified capability formula: the preceding phrase scopes it to their aid, while the root's measure-and-determination field makes the power precise, apportioned, and effective rather than raw force. The intensive adjective form presents stable capacity, and the closing position answers the opening passive permission by placing measured divine capability as the final frame. The same field links back to broad capability statements in 22:6 and 22:74 and forward to 22:40, where capability becomes pledged help.

topics.headline: final predicate over their aid
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah waits for this final predicate to complete the assurance, and that the capability is scoped to their aid.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the adjective the predicate and links the preceding aid phrase as its complement.

topics.headline: faʿīl intensity rather than simple ability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form gives stable, complete capacity rather than a one-time act or simple agentive ability.
topics.reason: The adjective form and contrast with a simple active-participle reading support the intensive quality payoff.

topics.headline: power as precise measure and enablement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine power over aid includes measured timing, amount, and outcome, while the local word remains the capability adjective.
topics.reason: Root-family measure, determining, and enabling senses enrich the attribute but do not replace the local adjective sense.

topics.headline: standard capability field specialized to this case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recognizable divine-capability formula field is specialized here to the wronged group's aid (22:6; 22:39; 22:74).
topics.reason: The rows explicitly contrast the standard broad formula with this ayah's scoped aid phrase and same-surah capability statements.

topics.headline: opening passive answered by final capability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's structural crescendo from withheld agents to emphatic divine capacity.
topics.reason: The final predicate closes the passive-to-divine-agency movement.

topics.headline: capacity prepares pledged help
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 22:39 grounds the possibility of aid before 22:40 states it as promised action.
topics.reason: The row names the forward movement from capability to sworn help.

topics.headline: resonant final cadence
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The cadence note is decorative here and adds no distinct lexical, grammatical, or inter-ayah payoff.
topics.reason: The closure and predicate-seal topics already preserve the final-position payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أُذِنَ and يُقَٰتَلُونَ are causally tied to the passive ظُلِمُوا۟, then closed by نَصْرِهِمْ and قَدِيرٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A party already subjected to reciprocal lethal pressure receives a license because a grievance exists; permission opens a defensive act, the wrong supplies its jurisdictional cause, and support is figured as vindication backed by effective capacity.

activation_trace.role: The literal license or permission supplies the legal gate rather than an unconditioned command.
Mutual fighting supplies two-party pressure, while the focus passive places the licensed group on the receiving side.
Complaint and demand for equitable redress make the stated wrong an adjudicative trigger.
Withholding and confinement from a right specify the injury that the permission answers.
Vindication of the wronged gives support a redressive, not merely triumphal, function.
Effective capacity secures the possibility of redress without making human force self-authorizing.

changed_reading.before: A general command to initiate war followed by a promise of victory.
changed_reading.after: A causally gated defensive license for people already under attack and deprived of right, with divine support functioning as possible vindication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ظُلِمُوا۟ ... نَصْرِهِمْ ... قَدِيرٌ can join wrong placement or deprivation to arrival, flow, and measured restoration.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrong is modeled as putting persons or rights out of place and withholding them; support can then be an arrival or a channel that returns what was displaced, while capacity supplies a defined measure. Combat remains an instrument inside restoration rather than the endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in the wrong place supplies the displacement that calls for re-placement.
Withholding a right supplies the blocked possession or access to be restored.
Arrival at a land gives support a spatial role of return or restored presence.
Channels arriving from afar supply a flow model for reconnecting what exclusion cut off.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit bounds the restorative means and scale.

changed_reading.before: Support means defeating the opposing fighters.
changed_reading.after: Support may mean a measured return of displaced people, rights, and access to their proper places, with fighting subordinate to that repair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُذِنَ can activate not only license but notification, listening, and acceptance, while ظُلِمُوا۟ supplies a grievance to be heard.
baseline_models.mechanism: The permission is also a communicative event: a grievance is received, a boundary is announced, and a conflict becomes publicly intelligible as authorized defense rather than private vengeance.

activation_trace.role: Listening and accepting what is heard supply the receptive side of recognizing the wrong.
Knowledge and public notification make authorization an announced boundary.
The complaint branch supplies the claim that must be heard before the announcement has redressive force.
Two-sided combat is the contested situation that the communicative ruling classifies.

changed_reading.before: Permission is an invisible switch that simply releases force.
changed_reading.after: Permission is also the hearing and public classification of a grievance, distinguishing defensive action from unannounced retaliation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus grants permission in the perfect passive but predicates capacity over نَصْرِهِمْ rather than narrating an accomplished victory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human defensive agency is opened now, while support remains under divine capability, planning, and timing. The clause therefore resists treating authorization as either a guarantee of immediate survival or proof that every later outcome ratifies the actors.

activation_trace.role: The granted license opens a human course of action in the present.
Aid and making the aided party prevail define the possible support without asserting that it has already occurred.
Capability marks sufficiency to act, not a disclosed timetable or automatic battlefield result.
Deliberative estimation keeps timing and form of support within ordered determination.

changed_reading.before: Once permission is granted, victory and survival are guaranteed on the actors' timetable.
changed_reading.after: Permission grants agency, while the form and timing of support remain distinct questions held within divine capability and determination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier obstruction of a common sacred route and space gives concrete content to the focus wrong: exclusion converts equal access into withheld right. The defensive license can therefore answer an access regime that precedes open fighting, not only an isolated bodily blow.

activation_trace.role: The focus combat remains the immediate anchor and prevents the access cue from becoming an independent theme.
Turning people away supplies the active obstruction that matures into the focus conflict.
Sanctity as protected right makes the barred access a breach of an owed immunity.
Equality between resident and visitor supplies the distributive norm violated by exclusion.
Withholding from a right links the earlier access injury directly to the focus cause ظُلِمُوا۟.

structural_cues: 22:25 precedes the focus with obstruction from the Sacred Mosque, explicitly equalized for resident and visitor, and calls the deviation ظلم.
The focus still names recipients as those being fought, so blocked access is antecedent injury rather than a free-standing warrant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, protected space, equality, and repeated ظلم; I infer that these form one antecedent chain culminating in the focus fighting. A live narrower alternative limits the focus cause to direct attack and treats 22:25 only as thematic background.

changed_reading.before: The wrong is unspecified private mistreatment that matters only once combat starts.
changed_reading.after: The wrong includes systematic denial of shared sacred access, with combat emerging from an already coercive architecture of exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first performs a public summons and later names ears, while hearing supplies understanding and compliance. These recurrences activate the focus permission as an audible, intelligible ruling that receives a grievance and publicly marks the boundary of legitimate defense.

activation_trace.role: The focus license remains the legal anchor for the communicative activation.
Public notification by a call supplies the outward announcement side of authorization.
The bodily ear supplies the receiving interface that makes the root's communicative circuit visible.
Attentive acceptance turns mere reception into recognition of what has been announced.
Understanding and compliance make hearing function as uptake of the ruling, not sound alone.

structural_cues: 22:27 uses the root as a public call that gathers people; 22:46 pairs ears with hearing and understanding around the focus.
The focus passive leaves the authorizing speaker implicit, increasing the force of the public-speech activation without identifying a human issuer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across call, permission, ear, and hearing; I infer a communicative chain from grievance reception to public classification. The live alternative is simple polysemy with no procedural implication.

changed_reading.before: Authorization is a private metaphysical release of force.
changed_reading.after: Authorization is also an announced and hearable judgment that makes the defensive status of the action publicly intelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, flesh and blood are denied access to God while protective piety is what reaches; divine دفع then wards harm from people in security or faith. The sequence revises the licensed fighting into a subordinate protective instrument and blocks its conversion into sacred blood-production.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat anchors the revision in the focus rather than in sacrificial imagery alone.
Reaching a destination supplies the explicit contrast between rejected blood and accepted protective piety.
Known blood supplies the material explicitly denied divine receipt, constraining sacralized violence.
The split root's flowing-blood image reinforces the same excluded material without collapsing its alternate mapped inventory.
Warding off harm gives taqwa a protective mechanics that carries into the focus permission.
Removing a harmful thing frames defense as repulsion rather than acquisition or expansion.
Security and settled trust supply the protected condition toward which repulsion is directed.

structural_cues: 22:37, 22:38, and 22:39 form an immediate sequence from rejected flesh and blood, to protective دفع, to permission for those being fought.
The focus cause remains that the recipients were wronged, not that blood itself has ritual value.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated blood-to-God relation, protective taqwa, divine repulsion, and then licensed fighting; I infer that the sequence subordinates force to protection and denies sacrificial glorification. An alternative treats 22:37 as closing an unrelated ritual unit and gives the adjacency less control.

changed_reading.before: Licensed bloodshed can itself become a sacred offering or proof of devotion.
changed_reading.after: The license is an anti-sacrificial protective measure: blood has no devotional destination, while warding harm and restoring security govern force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expulsion from homes identifies the focus wrong spatially; reciprocal دفع among human groups prevents structural collapse; the threatened objects are several kinds of worship place, not one faction's asset. Support thus protects a plural ecology in which divine naming remains materially possible.

activation_trace.role: Wrong placement anchors expulsion and threatened demolition back in the focus cause.
Forced passage outside supplies the concrete displacement suffered by the focus recipients.
Affiliation with and residence in a home makes expulsion a severing of situated belonging.
Pushing a harmful force aside supplies the balancing mechanism that prevents demolition.
Distinct portions of humanity supply multiple groups whose counter-pressure limits any one group's domination.
The collapse of buildings states the material failure that defensive counter-pressure prevents.
The branch naming Christian worship buildings makes the protected set explicitly non-singular in communal form.
Places of prayer and worship supply one mapped inventory for the protected institutional ecology.
The alternate mapped root also names worship places, preserving the split inventory's convergent contribution.
A designated place of prostration adds another concrete worship site protected from collapse.
Reciprocal aid joins divine support to human participation in maintaining the protective balance.

structural_cues: 22:40 grammatically continues the description of those licensed in 22:39 and specifies expulsion from homes for saying that God is their Lord.
The counterfactual demolition list spans hermitages, churches, prayer places, and mosques before returning to reciprocal support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, human counter-pressure, threatened buildings, multiple worship-site terms, and reciprocal support; I infer that preserving plural worship infrastructure is a purpose of the focus license. A live alternative reads the list only as a general image of devastation, not the license's normative scope.

changed_reading.before: Defense seeks the licensed group's victory and repossession alone.
changed_reading.after: Defense restores the expelled while preserving a plural public ecology of worship against monopolizing demolition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse tests the recipients after they obtain capacity: power must establish durable worship, circulate growth through alms, recognize public good, and restrain wrong. The focus permission is therefore audited by the social order it produces, while the final outcome is not possessed by the empowered group.

activation_trace.role: Capacity in the focus anchors the later question of how conferred capacity is exercised.
Empowerment supplies the condition under which the licensed group's conduct becomes observable.
Care, preservation, and responsible charge make establishment an ongoing custodial task.
Growth and increase give alms a distributive repair function after empowerment.
Recognizable good supplies a public norm toward which the restored order is directed.
Restraint from action supplies an internal brake on the conduct of the newly empowered.
The final outcome relocates ultimate closure beyond the group's possession of force or land.

structural_cues: 22:41 continues with the same relative group and makes its conduct under terrestrial empowerment the next test.
Prayer, alms, recognized good, restraint of wrong, and the outcome of affairs follow the combat permission without another military predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies empowerment followed by cultic, distributive, and normative acts; I infer these are outcome criteria for the focus license, not unrelated virtues. The alternative is that 22:41 merely describes the group without conditioning how 22:39 is read.

changed_reading.before: Success is achieved when the wronged acquire enough power to defeat or replace their opponents.
changed_reading.after: Success is tested after empowerment by worship, redistribution, recognizable good, and restraint, with ultimate outcome still belonging to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later migrants may be killed or die and still receive apportioned provision. This separates divine support from guaranteed battlefield survival: the focus promise of capacity can sustain the wronged across displacement and death rather than certify every immediate material outcome.

activation_trace.role: Aid in the focus is the claim whose temporal and material range the later sequence revises.
Movement from one home to another continues the focus recipients' displacement beyond the immediate conflict.
Actual loss of life prevents support from being reduced to invulnerability in combat.
Loss of life by death broadens the adverse outcome beyond being killed while preserving the following care.
Apportioned gift supplies a mode of support that remains operative after migration and death.

structural_cues: 22:58 explicitly coordinates being killed or dying after migration with a subsequent promise of provision.
The focus predicates capability for support, not immunity from the lethal branch of ق ت ل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, actual death, and ensuing provision; I infer that نصر in the focus cannot be equated with guaranteed survival. The live alternative keeps provision and support as separate promises without allowing one to revise the other.

changed_reading.before: Divine capacity for support guarantees that licensed defenders will survive and win materially.
changed_reading.after: Support can accompany agency without preventing death, extending as care and apportioned good beyond the immediate battlefield outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later response is explicitly matched to what was suffered, followed by renewed transgression against the responder and a promise of vindication; pardon and protective covering remain live beside it. This calibrates the focus license as equivalent counterforce with an off-ramp, not an expandable blank check.

activation_trace.role: The focus license is the legal opening that the later proportional structure bounds.
Consequence after an offense supplies a responsive, backward-linked action rather than initiation.
Equivalence and likeness impose a proportional ceiling on the response.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies renewed excess as the condition for promised vindication.
Vindication of the wronged repeats the focus support after proportionate response and renewed aggression.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense preserve a non-retaliatory off-ramp.
Protective covering supplies a second repair mode alongside equivalent counterforce.

structural_cues: 22:60 orders suffered action, equivalent response, renewed aggression, divine support, and then pardon and covering.
The sequence distinguishes response from excess by repeating the passive experience of being acted upon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalence, renewed transgression, support, pardon, and covering; I infer a ceiling and an off-ramp for the focus permission. A live alternative takes the divine names only as consolation and not as guidance for the response's shape.

changed_reading.before: Once wrong is established, the licensed side may escalate until it secures total victory.
changed_reading.after: The license authorizes bounded counterforce tied to equivalent injury and renewed aggression, while pardon remains a live route out of retaliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, the sky is continuously held back from falling and may fall only by permission, inside a frame of tenderness and mercy. The repeated permission root activates the focus license as a controlled exception within a larger regime of restraint, not as force's default release.

activation_trace.role: The focus license is the opening whose regulatory shape is revised by the later recurrence.
Continuous holding and confinement supply the surrounding default of restraint.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the potentially catastrophic motion that restraint controls.
Permission appears as the sole exception to ongoing holding, defining a narrow release condition.
Tender compassion orients the holding-and-permission system toward protection of people.
Merciful tenderness reinforces protection, rather than destructive release, as the governing end.

structural_cues: 22:65 places بِإِذْنِهِۦ after ongoing restraint of a catastrophic fall and before divine tenderness and mercy toward people.
The focus likewise opens with passive permission before naming the already pressured recipients and their wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holding, possible falling, permission, tenderness, and mercy; I infer a regulatory analogy in which restraint is default and release exceptional. The live alternative restricts 22:65 to cosmic governance and denies transfer to the conflict license.

changed_reading.before: Permission means that restraint has ended and force may now unfold on its own logic.
changed_reading.after: Permission is a narrow opening inside continuing restraint, justified by protection and still governed toward mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence denies any helper to wrongdoers, exposes invoked powers as unable to rescue, and then condemns failure to measure God before naming gathered strength and post-humiliation might. The focus capability clause is thus both a power contrast and a moral discrimination: capacity does not validate whoever possesses force.

activation_trace.role: Effective capability in the focus anchors the later correction of how power is measured.
The wrongdoer's withholding posture marks the side from whom support is explicitly absent.
The negated helper makes support morally unavailable to the wrongdoer rather than mechanically attached to power.
Failure to extract something from another's grip supplies the concrete rescue incapacity of false powers.
The opposite of strength marks both sides of the false rescue relation as incapable.
Measure and proper limit make the failure a mis-estimation, not only denial of abstract omnipotence.
Capability repeats the focus branch and corrects the powerless comparison.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies integrated capacity rather than isolated violence.
Might after humiliation answers the focus recipients' wrong without making humiliation of others the goal.

structural_cues: 22:71 denies a helper specifically to wrongdoers; 22:73 stages failed rescue and weakness; 22:74 repeats ق د ر before strength and might.
The focus assigns support to those wronged, preserving the same moral polarity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated support for wrongdoers, failed rescue, weakness, proper measure, strength, and might; I infer that the focus capability is discriminating rather than a theology of sheer force. The alternative treats these as separate polemics against worship objects with no feedback into 22:39.

changed_reading.before: The final capability clause supplies overwhelming power that validates the stronger side.
changed_reading.after: The clause corrects false measures of power while withholding support from wrongdoers; capacity serves redress and cannot be equated with domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing charge expands exertion to the full effort of worship, witness, prayer, alms, and protective attachment, while denying constriction and ending with helper language. The focus combat permission remains real but cannot totalize the community's striving or become a permanent condition of religion.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat anchors the narrower activity that the closing frame places within wider exertion.
Expenditure of full effort under hardship broadens striving beyond one form of combat.
Negated constriction prevents the licensed conflict from becoming an all-enclosing religious pressure.
The branch image of inescapable fighting is activated under explicit negation, exposing permanent combat as a contained possibility rather than the norm.
Holding that prevents and protects supplies attachment, rather than aggression, as the community's final posture.
The closing helper repeats focus support after the broader duties, relocating reliance beyond combat.

structural_cues: 22:78 coordinates striving with selection, lack of religious constriction, witness, prayer, alms, protective attachment, patronage, and help.
Combat vocabulary is absent from the closing command even though support vocabulary returns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies broad exertion, explicit non-constriction, protective attachment, and repeated help; I infer that these prevent 22:39 from defining all striving as combat. The live alternative allows جهاد here to include warfare more centrally while still retaining the noncombat sequence.

changed_reading.before: The permission to fight becomes the defining and continuing form of religious striving.
changed_reading.after: Combat is one exceptional response within broader exertion ordered toward worship, witness, provision, restraint, and protective reliance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the drink-dilution branch of ق ت ل is form-distant from يُقَٰتَلُونَ; it remains anchored through the same focus root, measured capacity, and 22:60's equivalence and pardon. Render only as a material analogy for reducing violence's intensity, never as the surface lexical meaning of the combat form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combat root's branch of breaking a drink's severity can interact with focus measure and the later proportional response.

activation_trace.role: Breaking a drink's harsh strength with water supplies the attenuation analogy for defensive counterforce.
Defined measure prevents attenuation from becoming an unlimited counter-intensity.
Equivalence supplies the calibrated amount of counterforce in the analogy.
Leaving punishment supplies the possible endpoint where intensity is reduced to non-retaliation.

changed_reading.before: Defensive force answers violent intensity by reproducing or exceeding it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, licensed counterforce acts like a reducing agent: enough to break aggression's severity, proportioned toward an eventual stop.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because rain and water-channel branches are remote from ordinary military support; it remains anchored in نَصْرِهِمْ, the measured قَدِيرٌ clause, and the packet's actual rain-to-green sequence. Render as an ecological model of restorative aid, not as a claim that نصر literally means rain here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The support root contains rain and converging water-channel branches, while the focus wrong can be withholding and capacity can be measured.

activation_trace.role: Withholding from a right supplies the dryness or blocked-flow side of the ecological model.
Rain and relief supply restorative aid that revives rather than conquers.
Channels arriving from afar supply distribution of aid into a shared basin.
Measured amount supplies calibration of restorative flow.
Delivering something downward supplies the arrival of restorative aid.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies the repair medium.
Flourishing and ease of life supply the social result of restored flow.
Gentle beneficence keeps restoration from being modeled only through overwhelming force.

changed_reading.before: Support is a decisive strike that destroys the opposing structure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, support is measured restorative flow that reconnects withheld goods and lets a damaged communal ground become livable again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 'fighter of winters' branch names one who defeats cold by feeding and warming people, far from the immediate combat form. It remains anchored in the focus ق ت ل and ن ص ر roots and is activated by post-migration provision in 22:58. Render only as a branch analogy that widens what defensive success sustains, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combat inventory includes defeating winters through provision, and the support inventory includes gift, while later displaced people receive apportioned provision.

activation_trace.role: Defeating winter by feeding and warming people supplies a nonlethal model of what a defender overcomes.
Support as gift makes provisioning part of restored communal capacity.
Movement between homes supplies the displaced population whose survival requires more than battlefield action.
Apportioned gift activates concrete sustenance as a mode of support after displacement.

changed_reading.before: The defenders' relevant work ends with repelling armed opponents.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, defense also defeats exposure, hunger, and displacement by sustaining the community that violence endangered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it tests the temporal threshold of يُقَٰتَلُونَ through a later near-action construction. It remains anchored in the focus reciprocal-combat form and the packet's branch for approaching an act, but it should be rendered only as a question about visibly imminent assault, never as a general legal rule or a license based on suspicion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive reciprocal combat form can be tested against a later context in which hostile action is described as nearing execution.

activation_trace.role: Mutual fighting supplies the focus threshold whose temporal edge is being explored.
Approaching an act supplies visible imminence without claiming that the act is already complete.

changed_reading.before: Permission becomes relevant only after completed lethal injury.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, being under an overtly imminent assault may belong to the passive state of being fought, though mere apprehension does not.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from a generic war command to an adjudicated defensive license caused by attack, withheld right, and a heard grievance.
The 22:37-40 sequence made the license anti-sacrificial and protective, then widened its object from one group's victory to homes and a plural ecology of worship.
22:41 and 22:60 audited force by what empowerment builds, imposed proportional response, and kept restraint and pardon live.
22:58 and 22:65 separated support from guaranteed survival and recast permission as a narrow opening inside continued protective restraint.
22:71-78 bounded capability morally and placed combat inside a wider field of exertion, witness, provision, worship, and protective reliance.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots opened several coexisting domains: permission became call, hearing, and controlled exception; wrong became complaint, deprivation, and displacement; support became vindication, restored presence, provision, rain, and converging channels; capacity became both effective power and measured limit. The packet's immediate anti-blood and plural-site sequence supplied the strongest surprise, while the dilution, hydraulic, winter-provisioning, and imminent-assault readings remained contained but live.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يُقَٰتَلُونَ denotes only combat already underway or can include an overtly imminent attack remains grammatically and normatively open.
The extent to which 22:40's several worship sites define the purpose of the license, rather than illustrating consequences of unchecked conflict, remains live.
The relation between divine دفع in 22:38 and human licensed action in 22:39 may be delegation, coordination, or two distinct modes of protection.
Arrival, rain, water-channel, dilution, and winter-provisioning branches are productive mechanism analogies but should not be promoted to surface lexical senses without further evidence.
Capability for support does not disclose its timing, form, or worldly outcome, especially given the later possibility of migration, killing, and death.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Combat is bounded by permission and redress.** `ء ذ ن B004` is authorization; `ق ت ل B011` mutual fighting; `ظ ل م B003/B004` grievance and wrongful placement; `ن ص ر B002/B001` redress after oppression and prevailing aid. The passive permission follows divine defense in 22:38 and is causally tied to being wronged. I infer that fighting is not self-authorizing aggression but a delimited means of correcting imposed harm. The verse reads permission as a legal boundary around force.
2. **Capacity stands behind, but does not erase, human action.** `ق د ر B003/B001` is effective power and measured extent. Divine capacity concludes a sentence permitting the oppressed to act. I infer that human resistance operates within, rather than substitutes for, measured divine aid. The final assurance reads as support that limits despair without granting unlimited violence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:40 immediately supplied the concrete protected goods: homes and varied worship spaces would be demolished without restraining defense.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Permission marks a bounded transition from being attacked to remedial force.** Fixed `أُذِن` activates `ء ذ ن:B004` (permission and authorization), and the passive `يُقَاتَلُون` activates `ق ت ل:B011` (mutual fighting) while preserving that fighting first acts on them. `ظُلِمُوا` activates the grievance/redress scope of `ظ ل م:B003`, `نَصْر` activates `ن ص ر:B002` (redress after oppression), and `قَدِير` uses `ق د ر:B003` (effective capacity). `22:38` supplies warding and `22:40` supplies expulsion and institutional stakes. The packet gives prior aggression, grievance, permission, and redress; I infer a licensed move into resistance. The ayah does not read as a free-standing command to initiate combat.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:40` specifies expulsion and threatened worship sites, sharply bounding the permission; `22:41` then supplies the positive conduct expected if the defended group gains power.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Defense protects not one building type but an ecology of distinct sacred enclosures, then turns survival into civic maintenance rather than unrestricted dominance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bilinen işitme organını temel alır ve biçim benzerliğiyle kap tutamağına aktarımı açıkça destekler. Kulaklı ya da büyük kulaklı olma, kulak biçimli parça yapma ve kulağa vurma gibi kullanımlar da bu somut çekirdeğe bağlı türevlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dinleme, bilme, bildirme veya bir işi yapma yetkisi verme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, organ adını merkezde tutar; kap tutamağı, niteleme ve eylem anlamlarını yalnızca kendi türemiş biçimlerine bağlı olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Kulak, işitmeye yarayan beden organıdır; benzer biçimli kap tutamaklarına aktarılır ve kulaklılık, büyük kulaklılık, kulak biçimli parça yapma ya da kulağa vurup ovma anlatımlarına temel olur.

facets.statement: Temel gönderge, canlıların işitmeye yarayan kulak organıdır.
Biçim benzerliğiyle bir kupa, kap veya tencerenin kulak biçimli tutamağını da gösterebilir.
Türemiş nitelemeler, kulağı bulunanı veya kulakları büyük olanı belirtir.
Türemiş eylemler, bir nesneye kulak biçimli parça eklemeyi ya da birinin kulağına vurup kulağını ovmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, beden organını ortak çekirdek sayar; kap tutamağını biçim benzerliğiyle bu çekirdeğe bağlar ve kulakla ilgili niteleme ile eylemleri aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın somut organ çekirdeğini ve nesnelere biçim benzerliğiyle aktarılan başlıca uzantısını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem beden organını hem de ona benzeyen tutamak uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlının işitme organından söz edilen olağan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beden organı olan temel göndergeyi eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Kap tutamağına aktarımı ve kulağa bağlı türemiş niteleme ile eylemleri dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.loses: Canlıdaki işitme organını ve öteki türemiş kullanımları dışarıda bırakır.

Bazı bağlamlarda dinleme, duyulanı kabul etmeyi ve buyruğa uymayı da içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bilme ile başkasına bildirmeyi aynı dalda açıkça kurar. Sesli duyuru, namazı ve namaz vaktini bildiren çağrı, çağrıyı yapan kişi ve çağrının yapıldığı ya da ulaştığı yer bu bilgi aktarımı çekirdeğine bağlı özel türevlerdir.

facets.statement: Birinci çekirdek yön, bir şey hakkında bilgi sahibi olmaktır.

Bildirme, genel bir sesli duyuruya veya özel olarak namazı ve namaz vaktini bildiren çağrıya özelleşebilir.
Türemiş adlar çağrıyı, çağrıyı yapan kişiyi, çağrının yapıldığı kuleyi veya sesin her yönden ulaştığı yeri gösterir.

Bilgi dahilinde olma tek başına yetkilendirme gerektirmediğinden izin merkezli dal çerçevesi bu açıklamayı ayrıca koruyacak biçimde nitelendirilmiştir. facets.statement: Temel ilişki, bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapma veya bir yere girme onayı ve yetkisi vermektir.

Bir işin birinin bilgisi dahilinde yapılması veya onun buyruğuyla yapılması, bu dalda korunan iki kaynak açıklamasıdır.
Kişi adı, yöneticiye veya başka bir yere girişe onay veren kapı görevlisini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, canın bedenden ayrılmasına yol açan öldürme eylemini ve bu sonucu doğuran çeşitli araçları açıkça bildirir. İnsan bedeninde vurulduğunda ölüm getiren yerler de aynı çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam, karşılıklı savaşmayı, yalnızca ölüm tehlikesi yaratmayı ve mecazlı bilgi kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım temel öldürme anlamını verir; kötü biçimde öldürme ve bedendeki ölümcül noktalar yalnızca kendi kalıplarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Canlı bir varlığın canını bedeninden ayırarak ölümüne yol açmaktır. Darbe, yara, taş, zehir ya da hastalık bu sonucu doğuran araçlardan olabilir.

facets.statement: Bir canlının yaşamını sona erdirip canını bedeninden ayırma eylemidir.
İnsan bedeninde vurulması ya da yaralanması ölüm getiren noktalar bu anlamın özel bir beden kullanımını oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamın özünü canın bedenden ayrılması ve bunun sonucunda ölümün gerçekleşmesi olarak birleştirir; kullanılan araç değişse de sonuç aynıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir canlının yaşamını doğrudan sona erdiren eylemin genel ve sonuç odaklı karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Canın alınması işlemini ve ölüm sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Araç ya da öldürme biçiminin ayrıca belirtilmediği olağan eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşamı sona erdiren eylemi doğal Türkçeyle tam olarak karşılar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan bedeninde isabet aldığında ölüme yol açan yerlerden söz edilirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedendeki ölüm getiren yerler yönünü açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel öldürme eylemini ve onun farklı araçlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onu kötü ve çirkin bir biçimde öldürme

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlam da canlılığın sona ermesi sonucunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Öldürme, sonucu doğuran eylemdir; ölüm ise bu eylemden bağımsız olarak da gerçekleşebilen olay ya da durumdur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlam her türlü tamamlanmış öldürmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam yalnızca önceden yaralanmış birinin öldürülmesini tamamlama aşamasına özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlamda da bir kişinin yaşamı bilinçli bir eylemle sona erdirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu anlam, yaralanmış kişiye son darbeyi vurma koşulunu taşır; odak anlam böyle bir ön aşama gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlam, karşılıklılık gerektirmeden ölüm sonucunun gerçekleşmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam, iki ya da daha çok tarafın öldürme amacıyla karşılıklı çatışmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlamda da öldürme amacı ya da ölüm olasılığı bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Karşılıklı savaş ölümle sonuçlanmayabilir; öldürme ise karşılıklı bir çatışma olmadan da gerçekleşebilir ve sonucu esas alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; eylem, ölüm durumu, yaralıyı son darbeyle öldürme ve karşılıklı savaşma sınırlarını en açık gösteren üç karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القتل المعروف، إزالة الروح، القتيل والقتلى، قتلة السوء، والتكثير في القتل، وما يصيب مقاتل الإنسان فيميته.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi boyun eğdirme ve işe alıştırma çekirdeğini destekler; deneyimli kişi kullanımı ise şiddetin yumuşaması değil, işlerce sınanıp pişmiş olma sonucudur. Bu nedenle çerçeve, eğitim ile deneyim sonucunu ayırarak kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Boyun eğdirme ve alıştırma temel kullanımdır; deneyimli kişi anlamı yalnızca belirtilen niteleme kalıbına bağlı bir uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel edilgenleştirme ve alıştırma anlamı, hayvanın işe alışmışlığı ile insanın deneyim kazanmışlığını bildiren kalıplardan ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı ya da hayvanı boyun eğdirmek veya yalnız hayvan için onu işe alışır duruma getirmektir. Belirli niteleme kalıplarında, işlerce sınanarak deneyim kazanmış kimseyi de anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir insanı ya da hayvanı direnci kırılmış ve uysal duruma getirme ya da özellikle hayvanı bir işe alıştırmadır.
İnsan için kullanıldığında, birçok işle sınanmış ve deneyim kazanmış olmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar boyun eğdirme, hayvanı işe alıştırma ve tekrar ya da sınanma yoluyla deneyimli hale gelme çizgisini birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: boyun eğdirme; hayvanı işe alıştırma; deneyimle pişme
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanı boyun eğdirme, hayvanı işe alıştırma ve insanın sınanarak deneyimli hale gelme kapsamlarını ayrı ayrı özetleyen açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğdirmeyi, hayvana bağlı işe alıştırmayı ve deneyim sonucu pişmeyi ayrı kapsamlarıyla korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özellikle bir hayvanın direncinin kırılması ve belirli bir işe alışması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğdirme ve düzenli işe alıştırma işlemlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: İnsan için sınanmış ve deneyimli olma uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın birçok durumla karşılaşıp bunları öğrenmiş olduğu niteleme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınanma sonucunda edinilen deneyim ve ustalık yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir canlıyı boyun eğdirme ve işe alıştırma işlemini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlam boyun eğdirme yönünü ve insan için deneyimle pişme uzantısını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam eğitim ve sık kullanım yoluyla beceri kazandırmayı daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam da bir canlıyı tekrar ve eğitimle kolay yönetilir hale getirmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta direncin kırılması belirgindir ve deneyimli insan uzantısı vardır; komşu anlam ise eğitme ve beceri kazandırma sürecine daha geniş yer verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlam, boyun eğdirmenin yanında işe alışma ve deneyim kazanma sonucunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam, eğitim ya da iş alışkanlığı gerektirmeyen genel bir boyun eğme durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlamda da direnç azalır ve uysal bir durum ortaya çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Boyun eğme yalnızca tutumu veya durumu bildirir; odak anlam bu durumu yaptırma ve çalışmaya alıştırma sürecini de içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şey, görüş ya da haber hakkında eksiksiz bilgiye ve kesinliğe ulaşmayı açıkça anlatır. Bu kullanım fiziksel öldürmeden bağımsız, belirli söz dizimlerine bağlı bir bilme anlamıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca eksiksiz ve kuşku bırakmayan bilgi bağlamındadır; sıradan bilme, sanı veya fiziksel öldürme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bilgi veya kesinlik bildiren belirtilmiş yapıya bağlıdır ve kökün yalın anlamı gibi genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey, görüş ya da haber hakkında kuşku bırakmayacak ölçüde eksiksiz bilgi edinip kesinliğe ulaşmaktır.

facets.statement: Bilgi konusu olan şeyi bütünüyle kavrayıp onun hakkında kesin bilgiye sahip olmadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, söz konusu yapıyı haber, görüş veya başka bir konu hakkında tam bilgi ve kesinlik kazanma biçiminde ortaklaşa açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir konuya ilişkin bilginin hem kapsamlı hem de kuşkudan uzak olduğunu anlatan tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin eksiksizliğini ve kesinliğini birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Kuşkunun bütünüyle giderildiğini tek başına açıkça bildirmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi eksiksiz ve kesin olarak bilmek

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam, kuşkunun giderildiği genel kesinlik durumunu ve buna ilişkin daha geniş türevleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam da kuşkunun ortadan kalktığı sağlam bilgiyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, bilgi nesnesini eksiksiz kavrama kalıbıdır; komşu ise herhangi bir yargının kesinleşmesini daha genel biçimde anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlam, bilginin eksiksiz ve kesin oluşunu zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam haber verme, sınama ve bir işin iç yüzünü tanıma süreçlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlamda da bir konu hakkında bilgi sahibi olma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Haber veya deneyim yoluyla bilgi edinmek kesinlik gerektirmez; odak anlamda tam kavrayış ve kesinlik kurucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kadının süslenip nazlı biçimde salınmasını, kişinin işine incelikle yaklaşmasını ve bir kadına yalvarmasını aynı dönüşlü yapı çevresinde açıkça tanıklar. Bu alt kullanımlar tanımda birbirine karıştırılmadan korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nazlı yürüyüş, bir işi elde etmek için yumuşak yol arama ve bir kadına yalvarma ayrı bağlamlardır; aşk yüzünden kendinden geçme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca belirtilen dönüşlü yapılarda geçerlidir; yalın köke genel bir nazlanma ya da yalvarma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kadının birine hoş görünmek için süslenip nazlı biçimde salınması ve bükülmesidir. Başka yapılarda, kişinin isteğine incelikle yaklaşmasını ya da bir kadına alçalarak yalvarmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir kadının hoş görünmek amacıyla süslenmesi, nazlanması ve yürürken salınıp bükülmesidir.
Bir kişinin gereksinimini elde etmek için ona incelikli ve yumuşak yollarla yaklaşmasıdır.
Bir erkeğin bir kadına kendini alçaltarak yalvarmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nazlı süslenme ve salınmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; aynı yapı, isteğe yumuşak yollarla yaklaşma ve bir kadına yalvarma bağlamlarına da uzanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kadının bir erkeğe hoş görünmek için görünüşünü ve yürüyüşünü değiştirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bir gereksinime incelikle yaklaşma ve bir kadına yalvarma uzantılarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir gereksinimi karşılamak için sabırla, yumuşaklıkla ve uygun yollar bularak davranma bağlamındadır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir isteğe incelikli ve yumuşak yollarla yaklaşma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Nazlı yürüyüşü ve bir kadına yalvarma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Kendini alçaltma ve yalvarma yönlerini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Nazlı salınma ile bir gereksinime ustaca yaklaşma yönlerini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gereksinimini ince ve yumuşak yollarla elde etmeye çalışmak

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam yalnızca kadının kocasına karşı nazlanıp bükülmesine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam da kadının bir erkeğe yönelik nazlı beden hareketini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kullanım eş ilişkisiyle sınırlıdır; odak kullanım daha geniş bir hoş görünme bağlamına ve ayrıca istek ile yalvarma uzantılarına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlam, hoş görünmeye yönelik süslenme ve denetimli nazlanmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam yürüyüşte gevşeklik, aşırılık ve kimi kullanımlarda ahlaki bir yargı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki anlamda da yürürken bükülme, salınma ve cilveli görünme bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak anlamın çekirdeği nazlı hoş görünmedir; komşu anlam hareketin gevşek ya da aşırı görünüşünü ve ek yargıları öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak anlamda bükülme, nazlanma ve birine hoş görünme amacı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu anlam insan ya da hayvanın yürüyüşünde, boynunda veya kalçasında yalın eğilip bükülmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam bedenin yürüyüş sırasında eğilip salınması görünümünde kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel bükülme tek başına naz ya da yöneltilmiş bir davranış değildir; odak anlamda bu toplumsal ve duygusal yön kurucudur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقتل الجارية أو المرأة للفتى في التزين والتثني والتكسر، وتقتل الرجل لحاجته أو للمرأة بمعنى التأتي والتضرع.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin temel bölümü birini öldürülmeye açık hale getirmeyi doğrular. Çeneler arasındaki ölüm nedeni sözü ise doğrudan birini tehlikeye atma eylemi değil, kişinin kendi sözlerinin ölümüne neden olabileceğini belirten ayrı bir kalıptır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tehlikeye açma temel kullanımdır; dilin ölüme neden olması yalnızca belirtilen atasözümsü kalıba bağlıdır ve gerçekleşmiş öldürme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Öldürülme tehlikesine açık kılma ile kişinin sözünü ölüm nedeni sayan kalıp ayrı tutulur; hiçbiri doğrudan öldürme sonucuyla özdeşleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Birini öldürülebileceği bir duruma sokmak ya da ölümüne yol açabilecek nedeni hazırlamaktır. Özel bir kalıpta, kişinin söyledikleri kendi ölümünün nedeni sayılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyi başkalarınca öldürülmeye açık ve savunmasız bir duruma getirmedir.
Kişinin diliyle söylediği sözlerin kendi ölümüne neden olabileceğini bildiren kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar birini ölüm tehlikesine açık bırakmayı ortak biçimde tanıklar; ayrıca kişinin dilini ve sözünü kendi ölümünün nedeni sayan kalıplaşmış bir anlatım verir.

concept_gloss.text: öldürülmeye açık kılma veya ölüm nedeni hazırlama
concept_gloss.applicability: Gerçekleşmiş ölümden önceki tehlikeye sokma işlemini ve kalıplaşmış neden bildirimini birlikte kapsar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başkalarınca öldürülebileceği koşullara bilerek veya neden olarak sokulduğu bağlamda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin söylediği sözlerin başına ölümcül bir sonuç getirebileceğini anlatan özdeyiş bağlamındadır.
